senses.gloss: m. (יָדָה) confession of sin, prayer for pardon. Tosef. Yoma V (VI), 14; Yoma 87ᵇ מצות ו׳ ערב וכ׳ the proper time for confession (on the entrance of the Day of Atonement) is &c.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 87b:7">Ib.</cite> <he>וחותם בו׳</he> and closes the benediction with an allusion to confession (forgiveness). Y. ib. VI, 43ᶜ <he>הו׳ מעכב</he> the confession (by the Highpriest, <cite ref="Leviticus 16:21">Lev. XVI, 21</cite>) is indispensible for the legality of the act.
Snh. VI, 2 וִידּוּיוֹ his (Achan’s) confession; a. fr.—Pl. (Chald.) וִידּוּיִין, וִידּוּיִן.

<cite ref="Shevuot 14a:8">Shebu. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>תרי ו׳</he> (Ms. F. <cite ref="U01585"><he>שני</he></cite>; Rashi <he>וִידּוּיֵי</he>) two confessions (<cite ref="Leviticus 16:6">Lev. XVI, 6</cite> a.
